exposure: achieving personalized weight target after GDM diagnosis
exceeding personalized weight target after GDM diagnosis
gaining less than personalized weight target after GDM diagnosis
cohort: The study included 1034 women with singleton gestational diabetes pregnancies from a multi-ethnic cohort.
finding: Weight management after gestational diabetes diagnosis can confer additional benefits to glucose-lowering treatment, resulting in lower mean insulin doses and lower rates of large for gestational age infants without increasing the risk of small for gestational age infants.
